newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to improve investment climate - president.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to improve investment climate - president.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma said his country intended to change the "close to negative" image of its foreign investment climate next year.

"One of the chief tasks for 1997 is to create a climate of trust, so that foreign investors are not afraid to enter the Ukrainian market," Kuchma told the National Agency for Reconstruction and Development in Ukraine on Thursday.
Foreign investors and some governments have criticised Ukraine for its imprecise laws, chaotic tax rules, high taxes, and corruption.
Ukraine has attracted only about $1.2 billion in foreign investment since independence in 1991. Foreign investment totalled $375.6 million in the first nine months of 1996.
Kuchma said foreign investment was of strategic importance for the economy, officially forecast to grow in 1997 for the first time since independence.
